open_points.subject: contents of a backup snapshot
open_points.text: A18 rule 1 says a backup "holds the store as its snapshot saw it" and that a later backup "holds whatever the store holds when its own snapshot is taken"; A18 rule 2 says every backup "holds every record but the agent sessions (M06), which are removed from the copy before it is encrypted".
open_points.question: Are the new statements about holding the snapshot subject to the existing exclusion of agent-session records, or must a backup now retain every record visible in the snapshot?
options: The backup snapshots all store state but removes every M06 AgentSession before encryption, so "holds the store" means the snapshot after that declared filtering.
The backup retains every record visible when the snapshot is taken, including M06 AgentSession records.
open_points.default_guess: Treat the new snapshot language as subject to A18 rule 2 and continue excluding agent sessions.

witness.initial: The store contains registered agent session S with a granted project when a daily backup's read transaction begins.
events: The backups module starts the daily run and asks the store module for its snapshot copy.
The backup is encrypted and kept.
The owner later restores that kept backup outside Registry.
outcomes: Under the new rule 1 wording, the restored store contains S because the backup holds whatever the snapshot saw.
Under A18 rule 2, S was removed before encryption and the restored store contains no agent session.
witness.observer: Cabinet Kernel and the owner, when S can either read its former access or must be registered and granted again after restore.
